title: Classic Wolfs Only
body:
**Don't Like the new wolf varients added in 1.20.5 (24w10a)?**

THIS PACK IS FOR YOU!!!

I have changed all textures for wolfs to be the classic white wolf we all know and love!

FAQ

Q: Does this pack support fresh animations?

A: Yes.
![Before and After of using the pack with fresh animations](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8037dd9867fee95cb77df3330fa44ce1065944ad.png)
_The Pack Working With Fresh animations_


Q: Does this pack remove the wolf personality sounds?

A: Not in 1.0.0 as I could not figure out how. try: https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/classic-wolf-sounds

_This Pack Was Made Using The Packcrafter Tool: packcrafter.net_
